name: sentence-fields
title: Sentence fields
description: A rule written as a sentence with the choices inline: "Email me every Monday at 09:00 about new orders", for digests, alerts and automations.
docs: Pass template and slots. The template is an array of plain words, { slot: "id" } for a choice and { text: "at", withSlot: "time" } for words that come and go with a slot, or one string with {id} marks ("Email me {frequency} at {time}."). A slot has an id, options (strings or { value, label }), a placeholder, a label and an optional when ({ slot, is } or { slot, not }) that hides it, and its words, while the condition fails; a hidden slot keeps its answer. value, defaultValue and onValueChange hold the whole object by slot id. Each slot is the house select drawn as an underlined word (typeahead, arrow keys), and Tab walks the slots in reading order. The sentence is a group named by its own words, and a slot is named "Frequency: every Monday". A choice longer than the line wraps inside its slot, and a very long word is broken, so a phone never scrolls sideways. onSentenceChange gets { text, complete } for a confirmation step; sentenceText() (in sentence.ts) writes the same text anywhere, also on the server.
